$\begin{align}-7p-4 & > 26p  -94 \\\\
-7p&> 26p-90 &(\text{Add } 4 \text{ to both sides}) \\\\
-33p &> -90 &(\text{Subtract } 26p \text{ from both sides})\\\\
33p&< 90&(\text{Multiply both sides by }-1)\\\\
p&<\dfrac{30}{11}&(\text{Divide both sides by }3 \text{ and simplify})
\end{align}$

[[☃ explanation 1]]

**In conclusion, the answer is $p < \dfrac{30}{11}$.**

options.explanation:
The inequality sign flips because we order negative numbers differently from positive numbers. 

For example, $2<3$. However, when we multiply both sides of the inequality by $-1$, we see that the inequality flips, because $-2>-3$. 

In general, if $u<k$, then it follows that $-u>-k$.
options.showPrompt: Why did the inequality sign flip when we multiplied by -1?
